bio.text: Kim Jackson, a Democrat, was elected to the Georgia State Senate in November 2020 to represent the 41st Senate District in DeKalb County; she was sworn in on January 11, 2021.
She was elected Senate Democratic Whip in 2024.
Her official biography describes her as an Episcopal priest from Cowpen, South Carolina, who graduated from Furman University and earned a Master of Divinity at Emory's Candler School of Theology.
